author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
Windows 10 officially lost Microsoft support on October 14th, 2025 — and nearly HALF of you are still running it. No more security updates means real, serious vulnerabilities. In this video, I break down what end-of-life actually means, why you can't just ignore it, and what your best options are: Windows 11, LTSC, Linux, or Mac. Don't wait until something goes wrong.

#Windows10 #Windows10EndOfLife #Windows10Dead #WindowsEOL #MicrosoftWindows
